correctness.rationale: The full combinatorial proof establishes exactly the forbidden mixed-vertex state criterion; every shortest path has one flip per edge; empty-open-set cuts produce a unique factorization into single-type indecomposable busy periods; labelled EGFs give S/(2-S), recurrence and coefficients. A uniform binomial convolution bound proves f_n/s_n->2 and hence g_n~2(2n)!/2^n. Independent monotone dynamic programming through n=8 and full unrestricted BFS through n=7 agree, but the infinite conclusion rests on the proof, not finite experiments.

value.rationale: Optimal-route multiplicity between canonical opposite acyclic orientations is an algorithmically meaningful robustness/choice invariant, not the familiar count of states or distance. The exact labelled two-type busy-period decomposition yields an O(n^2)-arithmetic coefficient algorithm on an exponential-state network, and the probability asymptotic 2^{1-n} precisely measures how severe the directed-cycle exclusion is for uniformly random shortest edge-orderings. The all-n theorem is a naturally posed complete enumeration, not an arbitrary finite slice.
